subject.title: [Feature]: Add realtime video frame transport for provider and gateway relay sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider/gateway realtime video-frame transport for relay sessions, and what consent, validation, logging, retention, and provider API contract should it require?
rationale: The code shape is identifiable, but this would expose camera-derived frames through stable gateway and plugin/provider surfaces, so automation cannot choose the security boundary or public API semantics.

options.title: Approve A Narrow One-Shot Contract
options.body: Allow a single-frame, explicit-consent gateway/provider transport only after payload validation, redaction/logging rules, provider mapping, docs, and tests are defined.

options.title: Keep Relay Unsupported For Now
options.body: Keep browser-direct visual context as the only supported path until maintainer review accepts a server-side frame boundary.

options.title: Move To Provider-Specific Plugins
options.body: Reject a core transport seam and ask individual provider plugins to expose their own visual-context capability outside the shared gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Approve A Narrow One-Shot Contract
recommendation.body: Allow a single-frame, explicit-consent gateway/provider transport only after payload validation, redaction/logging rules, provider mapping, docs, and tests are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to him and his history includes the active Talk runtime and SDK contract unification this decision would extend.
